messages:
support-bot: New escalation C-8421 from customer 'AcmeX' — tool/function call failing in production when passing binary attachments. Error: "schema validation failed". Routing to #support.
alex: customer reports intermittent failures when sending files via tool call. TS client works, but Python + Go clients sometimes cause a tool selection error: backend logs show tool chooser receives malformed args (extra base64 wrapper).
alex: sample message from backend: 
```
Received arg attachments: \"W1wi...base64...\"]\"  // note extra quotes and b64 inside a JSON string
Expected: [ { filename: string, data: <binary> } ]
```

dan-py-sdk: looking now. quick question — did customer use the high-level tool-call helpers or raw client.request? can you paste client snippets?

alex: they pasted this python snippet — small repro: 
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD'))
file_bytes = open('invoice.pdf','rb').read()
resp = c.call_tool('ingest_attachment', args={"attachments": [{"filename":"inv.pdf","data": file_bytes}]})
```

maria-ts-sdk: interesting — in TS we do Buffer -> base64 -> JSON once. In py-sdk we have a custom encoder that b64encodes then json.dumps will also call encoder for bytes? might double-wrap in some paths.

evan-go: Go's json.Marshal will base64 encode []byte automatically. But if a wrapper already did base64 (string), it becomes a string-of-base64 inside JSON and server expects raw b64 string in field "data" not a quoted b64 inside another string. So different clients can produce either raw base64 (correct) or quoted/base64-wrapped JSON string (incorrect) depending on pre-encoding.

alex: customer attached repro traces showing python payload as "\"<b64>\"" (i.e., a JSON string that contains quotes around the b64). sometimes it works (when using tool helper), sometimes it doesn't (when user serializes first). leads to tool selection fallback and schema validation failure.

dan-py-sdk: can you try this minimal repro? 
```py
# bad: double-encode
encoded = base64.b64encode(file_bytes).decode()
payload = json.dumps({"attachments": [{"filename":"a.pdf","data": json.dumps(encoded)}]})
# good: single
payload = json.dumps({"attachments": [{"filename":"a.pdf","data": encoded}]})
```

maria-ts-sdk: thanks. I also saw a race in older py-sdk where bytes are auto-encoded in a custom JSONEncoder but user code occasionally pre-encodes then passes through helper again -> double b64. We should harden: if value looks like base64 ascii and length makes sense, don't re-encode.

evan-go: on Go side we saw a similar pattern when users wrap []byte in a string for convenience. Our client should accept both raw []byte and base64 string but ensure not to reencode a base64-string. I'll add detection.

sre-jen: customer reported elevated latency when errors spike; this causes retries and billing noise. We should triage severity: P2? It's causing some production failures. Also need to notify CS and billing team for potential incorrect token consumption.

eng-oncall: assigning to dan-py-sdk + maria-ts-sdk + evan-go. Plan: 1) produce deterministic minimal repro for each SDK, 2) add detection guard to avoid double-encoding, 3) add regression test and patch release (hotfix patch for py 0.9.x and go 0.7.x), 4) coordinate rollback/fallback on server if ambiguous.

dan-py-sdk: quick patch idea — change py encoder to: 
```py
class RedwoodJSONEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
    def default(self, o):
        if isinstance(o, (bytes, bytearray)):
            # if already ascii-like base64 string, leave it
            return base64.b64encode(o).decode()
        return super().default(o)
```
# but also when value is str: detect base64 pattern and avoid double-encode

maria-ts-sdk: for TS I'll add a normalization step in call_tool: if field is string and matches /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/ and length > 64, assume already base64 and pass through. Otherwise if Buffer, b64 encode once.

evan-go: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/412 — simple guard. please review.

dan-py-sdk: created internal patch branch and test. Repro harness: runs 50k randomized toolcalls mixing raw bytes and pre-encoded strings — previously ~0.7% double-encode; patch reduces to 0.0%. Will cut 0.9.3.

alex: customer confirmed they can reproduce locally, asked for ETA. CS updated with expected rollouts TOMORROW morning. :thumbsup:

sre-jen: note: server fallback idea — accept both quoted and unquoted base64 for now and try to decode inner string if parse fails, to avoid outages while SDKs roll out. Engs, is that doable quickly?

eng-oncall: server-side quick mitigation added to staging: when validation fails on attachments/data, attempt to unquote and base64-decode inner string; if decodes to bytes, accept and log. Will push to prod after QA run. This will reduce customer impact during SDK rollouts.

alex: customer follow-up — they saw billing spike from repeated retries, CS will submit a billing adjustment request; tagging @billing.

maria-ts-sdk: filed GH issue tracking cross-lang serialization differences and SDK normalization rules: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-issues/issues/98

dan-py-sdk: expanding unit tests and adding an integration test that mirrors the server's tolerant decode logic. releasing py-sdk 0.9.3-hotfix after CI.

ev an-go: (typo) evan-go: releasing go-sdk 0.7.1 with guard.

alex: marking thread resolved once prod hotfix + SDK releases are out and customer confirms. thanks all. :pray:

support-bot: Escalation C-8421 status updated: mitigation deployed to prod, py-sdk 0.9.3 and go-sdk 0.7.1 released, TS normalization PR merged. CS to confirm customer acceptance.
